author: Animalogic
description:
Dugongs are majestic, goofy, adorable, strange, and mysterious all at the same time. No wonder why they've been mistaken for mythical creatures. But behind the myth, there's fantastic animal full of amazing evolutionary adaptations that help it survive in lands of little food and lots of predators. This is the dugong.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
